posts.title_kr: 콘텐츠 난이도 및 밸런스 개선 안내
posts.title_en: Notice: content difficulty and balance improvement
posts.summary_en: Official notice (2026-07-30 09:05 KST): the team found stage difficulty set higher than intended and applied a difficulty relief, with apology rewards and a raised 7-day attendance event. This is the first of three same-day difficulty changes.
mechanics: 2026-07-30 09:05 KST: official difficulty relief ('난이도 개선 작업을 진행하였습니다') because some content segments were harder than intended.
Commenter (아아앗뜨): stage 3-10 went from impossible to cleared in a second after the relief.

quotes.kr: 콘텐츠의 구간에서 의도했던 밸런스보다 높게 잡힌 난이도로 진행에 어려움을 겪고 계신 점을 확인하였습니다.
quotes.en: We confirmed that some content segments were set to a higher difficulty than the intended balance, making progress hard.

posts.title_kr: 난이도 밸런스 재조정 진행 및 사과 보상 안내 (7/30 22:40 내용 추가)
posts.title_en: Notice: difficulty re-adjustment and apology rewards
posts.summary_en: Official notice (2026-07-30 15:30 KST): the morning relief made content too easy, so difficulty was raised again at 2026-07-30 23:00 KST. Players who pushed far during the eased window would find stages suddenly harder. Comments report teams wiped by field mobs and progress fully stuck after the re-raise.
mechanics: 2026-07-30 23:00 KST: difficulty raised back ('일부 완화되었던 난이도를 적정 수준으로 재조정') after the 09:05 relief was judged excessive.
Notice: players who advanced many stages under the eased difficulty will find each stage harder after the patch.
Comments after the re-raise: teams wiped by field mobs (잡몹), not only bosses; no stage-select, so players were stuck; stage rankings effectively 'parked' (스테이지 랭킹 다 주차).
disagreements: Some commenters (로쿠띵, 크마왕) preferred the eased difficulty; others (바람) said the eased version was too easy.

quotes.kr: 기존 완화된 난이도에서 많은 스테이지를 진행하셨던 분들의 경우 ... 갑자기 전투가 다소 어려워지는 등의 경험이 발생 할 수 있습니다.
quotes.en: Those who progressed many stages under the eased difficulty may find battles suddenly harder.

posts.title_kr: 난이도 조정에 따른 불편에 대해 진심으로 사과드립니다.
posts.title_en: Apology for the inconvenience from the difficulty adjustment
posts.summary_en: Official apology (2026-07-30 18:12 KST, title timestamp) that the re-raise made combat far harder than intended; an overall re-adjustment was scheduled for 2026-07-31 01:30–02:00 KST, aimed at restoring step-by-step stage progression with growth. Comments mention the stage count at the time (168) and hard bosses (32-30, the biker rats).
mechanics: 2026-07-31 01:30–02:00 KST: overall difficulty re-adjustment ('전반적인 난이도 재조정') after the 7/30 re-raise was judged too high.
Commenter 이병: 168 stages existed at that time ('168스테에'); the biker rats (바이크 쥐) boss moves constantly, making clears luck-dependent rather than idle.
Commenters: 32-30 boss too hard; 15-1 hard for event rewards.
stage_types: Commenter 이병: boss stages with mobs plus a moving boss (the biker rats) need manual control; cookie AI charges into mobs.

quotes.kr: 밸런스 수정 이후 게임 전반의 전투 난이도가 의도했던 수준보다 과도하게 높게 설정되었음을 확인하였습니다.
quotes.en: After the balance change, overall combat difficulty was set excessively higher than intended.

posts.summary_en: Patch notes for 2026-08-13: Cool Mint (SSR, water charge) and the Rune Crystal dungeon. No stage extension. Stage-relevant: bulk-clear for guide quests over 30 stages of backlog, breakthrough (돌파력) stat gains doubled past level 101, decimal display of accuracy/evasion/focus/resistance/skill haste, and skill amp now applying to summons.
mechanics: 2026-08-13: no main-stage extension. Guide quests can be bulk-cleared when more than 30 stages' worth is unclaimed.
2026-08-13: breakthrough (돌파력) past step 101: ATK/DEF per level 1 -> 2, HP per level 10 -> 20.
2026-08-13: accuracy (명중), evasion, focus (집중), resistance and skill haste now display decimals (the actual values were already fractional).
2026-08-13: skill amp now applies to summons (higher skill amp -> summon ATK/DEF/HP up); Licorice skeleton ATK ratio relabelled (0-promo 20.7% -> 58.0%, same real damage).
Comments: players at the stage cap asked for more stages; many asked for a boss restart button; complaints about the biker (바이커) boss pattern.
disagreements: Commenter 엉덩방아: the biker boss is meant to stop progress for a while; others want it changed.

posts.summary_en: Patch notes for 2026-08-27: main stages extended to 248-30 and the breakthrough cap to step 1000; Brightseeker (TSSR light ranged), Pinot Noir (SSR dark support), Chargemellow pet, Guild Conquest and Tea Knight. Boss fights gained give-up and retry buttons, and manual control now moves all cookies together.
mechanics: 2026-08-27: main stages extended to 248-30 (from 168-30).
2026-08-27: breakthrough (돌파력) max step raised to 1000.
2026-08-27: boss fights get give-up (포기하기) and retry (다시하기) buttons.
2026-08-27: manual control now moves all cookies together instead of following the shortest-range cookie.
2026-08-27: cookie-talk popups disabled at boss start; dragging over top-of-screen buttons still controls cookies.
2026-08-27: chicken-bot collab monsters summonable in main stages with event tickets.
2026-08-27 bug fix: when buffs/debuffs on the same stat overlap, the stronger one now correctly takes priority.
Comment 그겅: stages extended without lifting the 10-star cap.

quotes.kr: 메인 스테이지가 248-30까지 추가 확장됩니다.
quotes.en: Main stages are extended to 248-30.

posts.title_kr: 신규 스테이지 퀘스트 보상 관련 향후 대응 방향 안내
posts.title_en: Notice: response plan on new-stage quest rewards
posts.summary_en: Official apology that quest rewards for the new 169-1+ stages felt poor; extra quests were promised plus apology rewards (2026-08-28 18:00 KST). Comments say the power requirement between stages was raised sharply with the extension while rewards fell.
mechanics: 2026-08-28: 169-1+ stages' quest rewards acknowledged as too low; new quests to be added.
Commenter 세링: the power cut (전투력컷) was raised a lot with the new stages.
Commenter 옵윤: from 169 the power hurdle between stages is wider than before.
Commenters 신쿤/딸피: from 169-1 rewards came per 5 bosses, thinning to one per 30 stages higher up.
Commenter 티팀: Cool Mint was nerfed without notice.

quotes.kr: 기존보다 스테이지 진입 시의 전투력 허들 간격이 더욱 넓어졌음에도 불구하고
quotes.en: even though the power-hurdle gap on entering stages became wider than before

posts.title_kr: 신규 스테이지 퀘스트 보상 개편 및 향후 적용 계획 안내
posts.summary_en: Official revamp of 169-1+ stage quest rewards, applied after the 2026-08-31 emergency maintenance with retroactive mail. Quest count went from 2,196 to 4,889 and new reward types (rune crystals, research stones, cookie EXP) were added. Commenters still called it a large cut versus pre-169 rewards.
mechanics: 2026-08-31: 169-1+ quest total 2,196 -> 4,889; advanced cookie cutters 3,660 -> 8,110; advanced pet tickets 3,660 -> 7,950; lucky dough 5,490 -> 12,225; crystals 36,600 -> 82,600; coins 73,200 -> 9,033,200; new: rune crystals 10,320, 1-minute speedups 2,100, cookie EXP 13,824,000, basic research stones 209,600, choco-gang 160.
2026-08-31: retroactive grant by mail for players already past 169-1.
disagreements: Commenter x3500: still about a 66% cut versus the old per-stage rewards; commenter 아르리: old rewards gave ~24,000 cutters by stage 80.

posts.summary_en: Patch notes for 2026-09-10: main stages extended to 328-30 and the five daily dungeons to 570; higher stage quest rewards including 1-hour auto-hunt rewards; research 90-2, fame 360, breakthrough 1,500. Boss HP bar now shows decimals so sub-0.5% HP no longer reads 0%. Comments say accuracy/focus cuts were raised and misses are heavy without them.
mechanics: 2026-09-10: main stages extended to 328-30.
2026-09-10: new stage quest rewards scaled up; new rewards: 1-hour auto-hunt rewards (coin, cookie EXP, basic research stone, rune crystal, lucky dough).
2026-09-10: Gnome lab basic research to 90-2, special to 16; fame max 360; breakthrough (돌파력) max 1,500.
2026-09-10: boss HP bar shows decimals; previously <0.5% remaining HP rounded to 0%, confusing whether the fight had ended.
2026-09-10 bug fix: identical buffs stacking now compare final stacked value so the strongest applies.
Commenter 로즈렌: accuracy/focus cuts (명중집중 컷) were raised; without accuracy and focus you miss a lot; 'stage relief' still needed because auto does not work.
Commenters: same mobs and bosses reused as stages rise; call for gentler stage difficulty.

quotes.kr: 명중집중 컷 높여놓고 이젠 명중집중 다 안끼면 미스작살남
quotes.en: They raised the accuracy/focus cut; now if you don't stack accuracy and focus you miss constantly.

posts.title_kr: 스테이지 정리 (조금씩 의견 받고 수정할 예정) 비겁/쿨링민트/망치공주/그루터기
posts.title_en: Stage summary: Coward / Cool Mint / Hammer Princess / Stump
posts.summary_en: Deck guide by 곰은사람을찢어 written at 168-30 (author at 170 by comments): a base auto deck, a CC-boss deck, a Cool Mint deck and a Coward deck, with Pancake as armour shred after the Dark Choco bug fix. The Coward play is: stall the first skills with Hound and Icy Birdie, short moves to stay on the boss, deal damage only on Skating Queen's ice, and hands off during fear. Only one crumblehub image (the first Coward model) could be viewed.

clears.note: Commenter 악림 cleared with this deck; Ion and Wind Archer clearing Cool Mint's adds were key.
Commenter 전종서: swapped Pancake for Dark Choco (8-star); Brightseeker 2-star still dealt good damage; 10-star Cool Mint did too little so swapped to Skating Queen.

teams.name: Coward first model (비겁이 전용 초기 모델)

cookies.note: author did not own it yet; used Milky Way in its place
used because author's Cool Mint is 10-star with perfect runes; Ion is the default

teams.why: Coward hits hard early; sustain plus Skating Queen's ice zone is where damage goes in.
substitutions: Cool Mint -> Ion if Cool Mint is weak
Brightseeker -> Milky Way
Low HP: pet -> 초코왕방울 or 얼음과자새
unorthodox: Pancake over Dark Choco for DEF shred

teams.name: Coward second model

cookies.role: ice zone to deal damage on

teams.why: Hound and Icy Birdie hold until Ion/Lime/Herb cast first skills; then their sustain allows short repeated moves onto Coward.

mechanics: Dark Choco had a bug that was fixed before 2026-08-28 (author considered Pancake after it).
Comment (곰은사람을찢어): after the 8/27 update the Cake Hound lost value.
stage_types: Base stages: Skating Queen almost fixed when no CC; Rockstar/Lime/Grapevine when sustain is short (desert, ruins, lava); Cheesecake when damage is short.
CC bosses (망치공주, 그루터기, 설인, 왕방울 - high HP, not recommended): the standard auto deck; after 8/27 Rockstar/Grapevine replace Hound.
Second CC deck: duration-synergy based, Scorpion main so it must be walked onto stumps/yeti; die instantly if Herb or Cool Mint focus you, control only on contact.

Cool Mint: Wind Archer for the fountain map's many adds; Brightseeker's skills scatter onto adds so it is unsuitable against Cool Mint; Milky Way for adds, DEF shred (Dark Choco/Pancake), sustain (Herb/Grapevine/Hound or Ion).
Cool Mint (comment): pushing it into a corner gets everyone killed by two Cool Mint skills at higher stages; Scorpion should fill stacks fast then kite.
disagreements: Comment CHesed suggested Strawberry Crepe to push adds and corner Cool Mint; author abandoned cornering because two skills wipe the team at higher stages.

quotes.kr: 공포 이후엔 쿠키들이 스킬을 써줄 때 까지 손을 대지 않습니다
quotes.en: After the fear, don't touch anything until the cookies have used their skills.

posts.title_en: Stages by boss type (after the Cool Mint stealth nerf)
posts.summary_en: After Cool Mint was nerfed, 곰은사람을찢어 rebuilt decks without depending on it: a general deck for normal stages and multi-boss fights (Macaron casts toward Milky Way, so steer or replace Milky Way with Brightseeker), and a Scorpion high-ceiling deck for single bosses and twin yetis. Pet guidance: Chargemellow normally; Kiwi Bird, Icy Birdie or King Choco Drop against hard-hitting bosses; Panda Dumpling and a DEF-shred cookie instead of Skating Queen against launch bosses.

teams.name: General / multi-boss deck

cookies.note: Macaron casts toward it; replace with Brightseeker when grown

teams.formation: crumblehub card image, 11 cookies, slot 12 open
teams.why: Open slot for DEF shred or sustain as the stage needs.
substitutions: DEF shred: 다크초코 / 팬케이크 / 악마
Sustain heal: 치약초코 / 라임 / 닥터뼈다구 / 포도넝쿨 / 천사; shield: 이온 / 락스타
Other: 브라이트시커 (dealer), 딸기크레페 (dealer-tank), 감초 (tank), 오렌지 (crit rate), 치즈케이크 (ATK amp), 명랑 (ATK reduction)

teams.name: Single-boss Scorpion deck

cookies.note: nerfed but good with Scorpion; drop it if yours is weak

teams.why: General deck with Wind Archer/Milky Way swapped for Tiger Lily/Scorpion plus Cool Mint.
substitutions: Weak Cool Mint -> DEF shred or sustain cookie
Pets: 전지멜로우 normally; 키위새/얼음과자/왕방울 vs hard hitters; launch (띄우는) bosses: drop Skating Queen for a DEF-shred cookie and use 판다만두

mechanics: Cool Mint was stealth-nerfed around 2026-08-28/30 ('쿨민 잠수함 패치').
Macaron casts its buff toward Milky Way (links cafe post 29088 on buff targeting); manual control needed so all cookies get skills.
stage_types: Ranged multi-bosses: dodge skills by moving, then close in; the bomber (폭파광) needs two 'dodge the dung' moves before closing in.
Launch bosses: Panda Dumpling pet, DEF-shred cookie instead of Skating Queen.

quotes.kr: 마카롱이 밀키방향으로 스킬쓴다는 점
quotes.en: Macaron casts its skill in Milky Way's direction.

posts.summary_en: Video guide by 서신우; the image shows a 5-star Brightseeker (about 250k KRW spent). In comments he gives his fallback ladder when short on power at 214-30 Cool Mint (asker needs 449M), ending with parking until the next day.
mechanics: When power is short: swap to dealers that add more team power; for Cool Mint, knock yourself right at the end of the tornado and split the hits so healers can be dropped; replace Grapevine with Pinot Noir; add a dealer in Lime's slot; if survival then fails, spend idle rewards or bag coins to grow, otherwise wait until the next day (park).
stage_types: Cool Mint: at tornado end bounce right and retry to split hits.

quotes.kr: 그것까지 사용하고도 안 되면 현재 한계가 거기라는 거니 다음 날 하는 식으로 진행합니다.
quotes.en: If it still fails after that, that's your current limit, so try again the next day.

The author (477M at 217-1) cleared at the 55% cut and recommends hitting it; Scorpion accuracy 932.12 and focus 789.34. A commenter pushing at 35% finds 210+ a wall; the author was then stuck at 224-30 at 35%.

stage_types: Coward: deal damage inside Skating Queen's field; stack Scorpion fast with Tiger Lily.

quotes.kr: 210 이후부터는 진짜 너무 벽인데 35% 트라이 클각 가능하다고 보시나요?
quotes.en: (commenter 신흥점) From 210 on it's a real wall — do you think 35% attempts can clear?

quotes.kr: 전갈 20스텍 풀로 박고 공포 나올때까지 보스피를 30프로도 못 까네요.
quotes.en: Even with full 20 Scorpion stacks I can't take 30% of the boss's HP before fear.

posts.summary_en: A nine-cookie base plus three dealers. The key is Pomegranate's buff order: its skill goes first to the projectile-speed receiver (Milk), then by highest ATK, reaching five cookies once Herb adds volley +2. Tune levels and runes so Milk, Skating Queen, Macaron and two dealers are the top-ATK cookies. For Coward and Cool Mint, drop Pinot Noir, Licorice and one dealer for Ion, GingerBright and Grapevine.

teams.name: Base 9 + 3 dealers

cookies.note: its ATK need not be tuned
captain; highest ATK; runes all ATK amp
runes 1 skill amp, 2 skill haste, 3 DMG reduction
must stay above the non-target cookies in ATK
dies early; still the best melee option

cookies.role: summons draw airborne aggro and soak big hits
cookies.note: runes skill amp, skill haste, DMG reduction

teams.perks: 열정페이 (ATK 7% perk first per text; switch to HP perk if damage isn't survivable)
teams.why: A buffed Skating Queen and Macaron lifting one dealer beats four dealers each receiving Pomegranate.
substitutions: Dealer options: 메론소다, 딸기크레페, 바람궁수, 위치베리, 쿨링민트; no 5-star Seeker -> Melon Soda or Crepe
Coward/Cool Mint: remove Pinot, Licorice, one dealer; add Ion, GingerBright, Grapevine (and Tiger Lily); pets 얼음과자새 or 왕방울 if damage too heavy
Macaron -> Lime (heal + crit buff, wider)
Stuck at 120-11: add Tiger Lily if Herb isn't 5-star
unorthodox: Levelling non-target cookies down to control Pomegranate's buff targets

builds.why: Milk must be highest-ATK for the passion-pay perk
with Milk's buff ATK amp is inefficient on dealers
skill haste so Tiger Lily casts before Pomegranate (both 10s CD) to give volley

mechanics: Pomegranate fires 3 regardless of stars; volley synergy raises the count; Herb's skill gives volley +2 so from its second skill it fires 5.
Pomegranate priority: projectile-speed (탄속) receiver first (Milk), then highest ATK at the moment of cast; Milk's ATK buff can let others steal the buff.
Volley drop-off on Scorpion is a duration issue: needs Milk's and Wasabi Octopus's duration synergy.
stage_types: Coward and Cool Mint use nearly the same deck; survive first, damage is enough with buffed Scorpion.
Hammer/stump bosses: Licorice summons pull airborne aggro.

quotes.kr: 석류버프를 딜러 4명이 받는 것보다 석류버프를 받은 피겨여왕, 마카롱의 버프를 받는 딜러 1명이 더 셉니다.
quotes.en: One dealer buffed by a Pomegranate-buffed Skating Queen and Macaron beats four dealers each taking Pomegranate's buff.

posts.title_en: How I set gear presets (stage / arena / single-boss)
posts.summary_en: Gear-preset guide by 레벅, updated 2026-09-23. The stage preset takes crit resistance (치저) for inflated power (뻥투력), which raises the bracket. Weapon gets skill amp + crit DMG; other slots skill amp, skill haste, DMG reduction, crit resistance; armour crit resistance + HP or DMG reduction. After a nerf, accuracy and focus of about 900 each is enough for stages; if they're too high, drop them for high-power gear. The auto-open filter screenshot checks crit DMG, crit resistance, skill amp, DMG reduction and skill haste.

builds.gear: Weapon: 스증 + 치피. Accessories: 스증/스가, 치저/스가. Armour: 치저 + 체력 or 피감 (* slots swappable). Auto-open filter: 치명피해, 치명저항, 스킬증폭, 피해감소, 스킬가속 (9/23: 스증, 스가, 치피, 피감, 명중).
builds.thresholds: 명중 and 집중 about 900+ each is enough for stages after the nerf
builds.why: 치저 inflates power (뻥투력), raising the power-adjust bracket; stage damage multiplier depends on power

builds.gear: Weapon 스증 + 치피; accessories 스가 + 스증 (or 스가 + 치피); armour 피감 + 체력
builds.why: Inflated power is useless in arena; HP beats crit resistance with HP pets

builds.gear: Weapon 치피 + 스증; accessories 스증 + 스가 and 스가 + 이속; armour 피감 + HP
builds.why: Move speed cuts run-in and post-airborne return time in timed boss fights

builds.sugar_runes: 스증 first (multiplicative with ATK and crit DMG); cookies whose skills don't scale with skill amp: 집중 + 스가
builds.why: Skill amp has no other source besides gear and Pomegranate

mechanics: Inflated power (뻥투력) from crit resistance counts only for the stage power adjustment; elsewhere substat priority matters more (author comment).
Low team power makes stages hard because of the stage power adjustment (author reply).
As of the 2026-09-23 edit: stages were nerfed so that ~900 accuracy and ~900 focus each suffice; if they're too high, uncheck them and pick high-power gear to raise the adjustment.
9/23 preset update noted in the header.
disagreements: Milk runes: author 레벅 argues ATK amp and skill amp at ~1:1 (lab already gives 350%+ ATK amp by lab 79 / guild lab 13); commenters 차나리, Thiss and '가방은 항상 두개' (at stage 290) insist on all-ATK-amp Milk so it wins the passion-pay +20% ATK perk and because Pomegranate already gives 200%+ skill amp.
Arena: author says HP over crit resistance and evasion is useless; others use crit resistance.

posts.summary_en: Gear-power weighting: gear power is designed around balanced stats, so duplicate stats add little and filling a missing stat adds a lot; heavy accuracy/focus gear lowers team power and hurts the power adjustment. Focus only matters if accuracy lands first (a miss means 0% debuff chance). Recommendation by bracket: 35% attempt = accuracy/focus-heavy gear; 55% = combat gear with a little accuracy/focus; 75%+ = any options. Images could not be viewed.

builds.gear: 35% attempts: accuracy/focus-focused set (lower power but fewer retries). 55% attempts: combat set (balanced options, higher power) with a little accuracy/focus. 75%+: pick wanted options.
builds.why: Power weighting per stat: balanced stats raise power; accuracy/focus-heavy lowers it

mechanics: Same item gives different power depending on current stats (e.g. necklace focus -> skill amp raised a sword's power ~300k); overstacking a stat can reduce power.
Miss = 0% debuff chance; on hit, skill chance plus focus vs resistance applies. The official answer declined to give the focus/resistance formula.
Commenter reply: hit chance appears to combine own accuracy + accuracy% against enemy evasion + evasion%.

quotes.en: 35% attempt = accuracy/focus set; 55% attempt = combat set with a little accuracy/focus; 75%+ = whatever options you want.

ATK order: Milk, Scorpion, Skating Queen, Brightseeker, with Lime 4th–5th ideally. Perk: support HP up (Passion Pay at Lv4 mercs); pets Holy Baby Drop, King Choco Drop, Wasabi Octopus; a 5★ Seeker is recommended. The post gives a detailed fire-breath sequence.

stage_types: Coward at 35%: drag right at once so GingerBright and the boss touch; after ~0.5s release and drag right again; if GingerBright's ATK-down misses, retry. When the boss dashes, move only as far as needed for Scorpion's 10 stacks and stop before the first fire. Survive the 2nd fire and the 3rd–4th are usually fine. After the first fire, only drag to regroup; get dealers onto the ice field and stay still. Near the end of the 4th fire, centre the boss and split cookies left/right so fear sends them opposite ways. If that fails, don't force damage in the 5th fire; dodge, then stick. Briefly releasing the drag lets skills fire.

posts.title_en: Stage decks: Espresso + Milky Way ranged decks
posts.summary_en: Synergy-routing guide by 곰은사람을찢어. Givers cast on receivers first, then the highest-ATK receiver, then the highest-ATK cookie. Make Espresso the top range-synergy receiver so Macaron casts on it from the deck centre and every dealer (Brightseeker especially) gets Macaron's buff; lower Milky Way's level. Three ranged decks, all captained by Brightseeker with Ammo Provided + Passion Pay: a volley deck for single bosses, a Twizzly deck for 2+ bosses and a Pinot deck for CC resistance. Lowering many dealers to route Pomegranate onto Macaron drops deck power below the 55% adjustment, so he tunes against Skating Queen's ATK instead.

mechanics: Synergy givers target receivers first; among several receivers, the highest ATK; with none, the highest-ATK cookie in the deck.
Pomegranate gives projectile-speed synergy: Milk first, then others by ATK.
Tuning so Macaron also receives Pomegranate would drop deck power below the 55% power adjustment (author reply).
If your Seeker is weaker than your Wind Archer, this doesn't apply; with a 6★ Seeker, make Milk ATK #1 and captain instead.
stage_types: The Twizzly deck kills mobs fastest; Coward and Cool Mint get their own presets.
